fields.name: ClusteringExtensions.UseArgentSeaClustering (ISiloBuilder)
fields.contract: Configures an Orleans silo builder for ArgentSea clustering. Both overloads register singleton IMembershipTable resolution as ArgentSeaOrleansMembershipTable and singleton IConfigurationValidator resolution as ClusterOptionsValidator. The overload with an Action<IConfiguration> applies a non-null action to service configuration before those registrations; a null action is skipped. The parameterless overload binds the builder Configuration to ClusterOptions before those registrations. Each overload returns the configured ISiloBuilder.
